relevance_note: MED — hazard benchmark with distant and intruding objects.
what: Image-editing pipeline to synthesize hazards; MovSafeBench is an MCQ benchmark with 7,254 images over 13 object categories, normal and anomalous objects. Built on DriveBench and SA-Bench (per search summary; four scenario types motion/intrusion/distance/static also from the summary, UNVERIFIED).
thesis_use: image-edited hazards for the VLM-feature part; the "distance" scenario type matches distance ambiguity.

title: VOILA: Value-of-Information Guided Fidelity Selection for Cost-Aware Multimodal Question Answering
relevance_note: MED-HIGH — learned predictor of correctness per option plus a VoI utility rule selecting which option to buy.
what: Gradient-boosted regressor predicts correctness at each fidelity from question features, isotonic calibration, then picks the minimum-cost fidelity maximizing expected utility. Five datasets, six VLMs: 50-60% cost reduction at 90-95% of full-resolution accuracy.
thesis_use: very close in recipe to the MLP selector on expected-gain targets (predict per-option correctness, select under cost); cite as precedent.

title: When Environments Shift: Safe Planning with Generative Priors and Robust Conformal Prediction
relevance_note: MED — conformal-MPC safety guarantee that survives distribution shift (traffic density) using diffusion-generated data and robust CP; ORCA simulator.
thesis_use: idea for calibration under shift (noise level as nuisance parameter).

title: When to Trust the Cheap Check: Weak and Strong Verification for Reasoning
relevance_note: MED — optimal two-threshold accept/reject/defer policy for cheap vs costly verification, with online error control.
what: Formalises weak-strong verification policies that accept or reject on the weak signal and defer to strong verification otherwise. Shows optimal policies have a two-threshold structure and gives an online algorithm controlling acceptance and rejection errors.
thesis_use: Matches the future accept/inspect/replan/fallback policy: two thresholds on a calibrated score, with the strong check as the tool call.

title: Risk-Aware World Model Predictive Control for Generalizable End-to-End Autonomous Driving
relevance_note: MED — a world model predicts consequences of multiple candidate actions and picks low-risk ones with explicit risk evaluation, with no expert supervision.
thesis_use: baseline concept for risk-evaluated selection; generalization claim to long-tail.

title: Act, Think or Abstain: Complexity-Aware Adaptive Inference for Vision-Language-Action Models
relevance_note: MED — routes VLA execution into Act / Think / Abstain via embedding-based complexity estimators.
what: Uses the backbone's latent embeddings as an active detection tool for state complexity.
thesis_use: three-way decision analog (act/reason/abstain); uses frozen backbone embeddings like the project's frozen-VLM features.

title: Consistent Learning-to-Defer with Expert-Conditional Advice
relevance_note: MED-HIGH — learns both which expert handles an input and which information they receive, with acquisition fees; handles training data where only a subset of advice is observed.
what: Proposes reference conditional classification with consistency bounds; on FEVER and Sensitive, full training has lowest dev loss at every fee and limited training helps at most matched budgets.
thesis_use: theory for "which query + cost" selectors and for training with partially observed tool outcomes.

title: SparseDriveV2: Scoring is All You Need for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
relevance_note: MED — scaling study of Hydra-MDP: performance rises as anchors get denser without saturation; factorized path-times-velocity vocabulary.
what: Verbatim abstract (html): "SparseDriveV2 scales the trajectory vocabulary to be 32 denser than prior methods ... With a lightweight ResNet-34 as backbone, SparseDriveV2 achieves 92.0 PDMS and 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM, with 89.15 Driving Score and 70.00 Success Rate on Bench2Drive."
thesis_use: baseline / background for scorer scaling.

title: Therefore I am. I Think
relevance_note: MED — linear probe decodes tool-calling decisions from pre-generation activations; steering flips behavior in 7-79% of examples depending on model/benchmark.
what: Argues the decision is encoded before reasoning; CoT often rationalizes.
thesis_use: supports probing over prompting.

title: Bench2Drive-VL: Benchmarks for Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving with Vision-Language Models
relevance_note: MED — closed-loop VLM driving in CARLA, plug-in interface and configurable graph-based CoT.
what: Extends Bench2Drive with DriveCommenter (behavior-grounded QA generator, including off-route states) and a unified interface to plug VLMs into the closed loop.
thesis_use: future closed-loop validation target after the open-loop MetaDrive study.

title: Act Wisely: Cultivating Meta-Cognitive Tool Use in Agentic Multimodal Models
relevance_note: MED-HIGH — names "blind tool invocation" in a VLM and fixes it with a conditional efficiency reward; closest VLM competitor for learned when-to-call.
what: Argues a scalarized tool penalty either suppresses essential tool use or is swamped by accuracy-reward variance. HDPO keeps an accuracy channel and an efficiency channel that applies "exclusively within accurate trajectories via conditional advantage estimation". Abstract: Metis "reduces tool invocations by orders of magnitude (e.g., from 98% to 2%) while simultaneously elevating reasoning accuracy" (Qwen3-VL-8B base).
thesis_use: related work and a baseline family (RL-trained caller); contrast with the supervised expected-gain selector. The 98% vs 2% number supports "base VLMs call blindly", opposite to the project's "none" behavior for a prompted Qwen3.5-9B, so state the two failure modes explicitly.

title: Orion-Lite: Distilling LLM Reasoning into Efficient Vision-Only Driving Models
relevance_note: MED — latent feature distillation from ORION's LLM plus ground-truth trajectory supervision; student surpasses teacher on Bench2Drive (DS 80.6).
thesis_use: alternative to test-time VLM features (distill into the selector); closed-loop evidence.

title: CORA: Conformal Risk-Controlled Agents for Safeguarded Mobile GUI Automation
relevance_note: MED — Guardian model estimates action-conditional risk per proposed step; conformal risk control sets execute/abstain boundary; rejected actions routed to a Diagnostician (confirm, reflect, abort).
what: VLM GUI agent safeguard with user-specified risk budget.
thesis_use: pattern for accept/inspect/fallback with CRC.

title: BridgeSim: Unveiling the OL-CL Gap in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
relevance_note: MED-LOW — explains why open-loop policies fail in closed loop: observational domain shift and objective mismatch (a biased Q-value that ignores reactive behaviour and temporal awareness); proposes test-time adaptation.
what: "our analysis highlights the existence of blind spots in standard OL evaluation protocols that fail to capture the realities of closed-loop deployment" (abstract; no numbers in it).
thesis_use: cite with 2605.00066 for the open-loop limitation; supports keeping closed-loop MetaDrive as a later phase.

title: RAD-2: Scaling Reinforcement Learning in a Generator-Discriminator Framework
relevance_note: MED — diffusion generator plus RL-trained discriminator that reranks candidates by long-term driving quality.
what: Collision rate reduced 56% versus strong diffusion-based planners (abstract); closed-loop BEV-Warp simulation.
thesis_use: baseline design for ranker; closed-loop extension reference.

title: Robot Planning and Situation Handling with Active Perception
relevance_note: MED — uses action knowledge (the plan's actions) to prompt a VLM for active view selection and situation assessment inside a task-and-motion planner; this is plan-conditioned view selection, the nearest robotics analog to candidate-conditioned queries.
what: Service tasks in simulation and on a mobile manipulator; no numbers in abstract.
thesis_use: closest plan-conditioned active-perception precedent outside driving.

title: Do Open-Loop Metrics Predict Closed-Loop Driving? A Cross-Benchmark Correlation Study of NAVSIM and Bench2Drive
relevance_note: MED — direct evidence on how far an open-loop score like ours can be trusted.
what: Pairs published results of 15 methods across NAVSIM (open-loop) and Bench2Drive (closed-loop), 8 with complete paired data. Aggregate PDM Score correlates strongly but non-monotonically with Driving Score with ranking inversions; Ego Progress is the best single predictor; methods that maximize safety at the expense of progress rank high open-loop and underperform closed-loop; a 3-metric formula matches the 5-metric PDMS at Spearman rho=0.90 on n=8 (abstract).
thesis_use: limitation paragraph: open-loop decision accuracy is a proxy; n=8 is small. Also a reason to report a progress-like term (not only collision avoidance) in the oracle.

title: Adaptive Generate-Rank-Verify: Inference-Time Search with Costly Verification
venue: ICML 2026 (per search result, not checked on the abs page)
relevance_note: MED — cheap score then costly verifier, with an adaptive policy for how many candidates to verify; candidate set plus budget.
what: Models cheap reward + expensive verifier as cost-sensitive first-positive search, characterises the optimal policy by dynamic programming when distributions are known, and gives an online policy (ADAP) when they are not. Tested on maths and code.
thesis_use: Structural analogue: choose which of K candidates to spend a costly check on. Best-of-Evidence cites it in the same cluster.

title: VL-DPO: Vision-Language-Guided Finetuning for Preference-Aligned Autonomous Driving
relevance_note: MED — frozen VLM zero-shot selects the preferred trajectory among model rollouts to build DPO pairs on WOD-E2E.
what: VLM trajectory selection is a "high-quality proxy" for human preference; +11.94% RFS, -10.01% ADE over the pretrained model (abstract).
thesis_use: evidence that a frozen VLM can rank trajectories when used offline for labels, a different use from per-step prompting.

title: Are Tools Always Beneficial? Learning to Invoke Tools Adaptively for Dual-Mode Multimodal LLM Reasoning
venue: ICML 2026 (venue from a search listing only)
relevance_note: MED — RL for tool-on/tool-off modes in a MLLM; reports the policy drifts toward tool-off.
what: Dual-mode reasoning with mode-specific rewards (MSPO) and mode balancing; 21.8% accuracy gain on V* over base and 44.9% efficiency gain on POPE vs tool-augmented methods.
thesis_use: related work on whether-to-call; the tool-off bias is parallel to the project's VLM saying "none".

title: Do Vision-Language Models Understand 3D Scenes or Just Catalogue Objects?
relevance_note: MED — occlusion accuracy 6-45% for six VLMs; on Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking spatial info present in the vision encoder becomes inaccessible after the token merger and recovers when clean post-merger activations are patched in.
what: 3,034-sample benchmark, 18,204 responses with human scoring.
thesis_use: evidence that frozen VLMs fail on occlusion, supporting an occlusion/ROI tool; suggests reading embeddings before the merger.

title: D2-V2X: Depth-Driven Cooperative V2X Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
relevance_note: MED — QRA benchmark of 8,500 triplets targeting occluded hazards; the zero-shot VLM scores near zero on occluded hazards, the LiDAR-grounded model gets 24.4% recall.
what: Cooperative V2X sensors; also reports a 77% cut in spatial estimation error for visible objects vs zero-shot.
thesis_use: evidence that zero-shot VLMs miss occluded hazards, supporting the need for an ROI/reveal tool.

title: Seeing Isn't Knowing: Do VLMs Know When Not to Answer Spatial Questions (and Why)?
relevance_note: MED — SPATIALUNCERTAIN: VLM behaviour does not track evidence reliability under occlusion; models that can name an informative viewpoint often do not realise they need one; internal analysis shows 2D relations readily decodable, 3D barely.
what: Eight VLMs; failures not resolved by prompting or fine-tuning; a better viewpoint helps more than adding depth to the same view.
thesis_use: supports the failure of prompted tool choice ("none") and the premise that the selector cannot rely on VLM self-assessment.

title: Learning When Not to Act: Mitigating Tool Abuse in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
relevance_note: MED — selective tool use with difficulty-aware shaping; vs GRPO +10.45%/+7.27%/+9.69% average performance and -18.33%/-18.33%/-24.59% tool calls on three models.
what: Tool-free trajectories in each rollout group.
thesis_use: related work on uniform penalty vs selective use.

title: Vault: One-Step Latent Generation with Positive-Anchored Rewards for Autonomous Driving
relevance_note: MED — v1 fully fine-tunes Qwen 3.5 0.8B on driving QA and uses its hidden states for (a) an Adaptive Scheduler that picks the conditioning coefficient and number of samples from a discrete set (a compute budget per scene) and (b) a cross-attention scorer over candidate trajectories. PDMS 93.7 on NAVSIM v1 (v1 abstract). The earlier "mislabel" in my first report was wrong: the id is right, the record changed between v1 and v2; the absfetch record shows v2 (Vault).
thesis_use: hidden-state-driven budget choice plus candidate scoring; Qwen3.5-family in the loop, though fine-tuned and not frozen.

title: Test-Time Trajectory Optimization for Autonomous Driving
relevance_note: MED — treats the scorer as a trajectory-level reward and runs the Cross-Entropy Method at test time, warm-started from proposals.
what: Across seven planners, NAVSIM-v1 reaches 94.7 PDMS, NAVSIM-v2 56.3 EPDMS, and HUGSIM closed-loop improves (abstract).
thesis_use: background for verifier-guided search; shows weak candidate sets cap scorer quality, relevant to K = 3-5 candidate design.

title: Diagnosing Visual Ignorance in Vision-Language Models
relevance_note: MED — across three VLMs and twelve benchmarks, answer-relevant visual evidence is decodable from intermediate decoder layers but has little effect on the output until the final layers; late states are needed to shift the answer; many predictions survive progressive blur.
thesis_use: explains why a probe on mid layers can beat prompting, and why "VLM says none" is not evidence the VLM lacks the cue.

title: DriveReward: A Comprehensive Dataset and Generative Vision-Language Reward Model for Autonomous Driving
relevance_note: MED — 1B VLM reward model for RL and multi-modal trajectory scoring.
what: Reasoning trajectory-evaluation dataset with counterfactual behaviours. Leading VLMs fail to excel across tasks; the 1B model outperforms larger VLMs on task reward alignment and matches rule-based rewards in RL finetuning and trajectory scoring (abstract).
thesis_use: evidence that general VLMs are weak trajectory judges; supports the project's observation.

title: ProbeAct: Probe-Guided Training-Free Failure Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Models
relevance_note: MED — layer by pooling sweep on a frozen OpenVLA-OFT: Table 4 regression score at layer 8 is 0.968 (image-spatial), 0.926 (image-mean), 0.815 (last token), 0.869 (language-mean); layer 12 gives 0.958/0.919/0.856/0.879. "Spatial pooling dominates at every layer"; geometry peaks at shallow-mid layers and decays deeper.
thesis_use: evidence that last-token and mean pooling lose spatial information, and middle layers beat deep ones for geometric facts (object 3D position). Motivates keeping a small spatial grid of image tokens for distance and occlusion cues rather than a single mean vector. Manipulation, not driving, and not a Qwen model.

title: DrivingAgent: Design and Scheduling Agents for Autonomous Driving Systems
relevance_note: MED — RL-trained lightweight LLM schedules perception modules in real time (reuse/refresh/skip per module, per the search summary, not abstract) under latency constraints.
thesis_use: related work on module-level scheduling under a budget; the scheduler sees system state, no candidate trajectories (not confirmed beyond the abstract).

title: When and How Severely: Scenario-Specific Safety Envelopes for Driving VLAs
venue: arXiv preprint (OpenAlex also lists a Springer 2026 chapter)
relevance_note: MED — follow-up to Lost in Fog; safety envelope per scenario type under pixel noise.
what: Alpamayo R1 on 15,968 (clip, attack) pairs; aggregate safe threshold sigma <= 50 under a 15% ADE budget hides scenarios tolerating sigma = 70; a Gaussian mixture finds six severity bands.
thesis_use: per-scenario-type noise tolerance supports hazard-specific tool-noise levels; relevant to the future calibration phase.

title: Budget-Adaptive Routing: Skipping the Weak When the Strong Answers Anyway
venue: Workshop on Networks for AI Computing (NAIC '26) per DEEP bibliography
relevance_note: MED — routing/offload estimator under a varying budget; closest structure to an equal-budget Pareto comparison.
what: Weak-skipping estimator from raw pixels (0.153 GFLOPs, about 29x lighter than the weak detector, per abstract) and a router that chooses between weak-skipping and weak-conditioned placement by offload budget. Evaluated as an accuracy-compute frontier.
thesis_use: Evaluation template: compare allocators along the whole budget curve and charge the allocator for its own cost.

title: Decodable Is Not Grounded: A Vision-Ablation Arbiter for VLM Spatial Reasoning
relevance_note: MED — warns linear probes decode 73-97% on spatial axes, but blank-image control shows many are language priors; depth axis is "inverted" in 14 models.
what: Introduces a vision-ablation arbiter; three regimes (grounded, prior, inverted).
thesis_use: caution/control to add to any probe or embedding-gain claim (replace image with gray blank).

title: CritiqueDriveVLM: From Verifier-Guided Reinforcement Learning to Latent Thought Distillation for Autonomous Driving
venue: arXiv preprint (OpenAlex also lists a Springer chapter)
relevance_note: MED — argues tool-augmented frameworks cost too many tokens and too much latency, and internalizes reasoning instead.
what: Critique-driven multi-turn RL gives a tool-free teacher (MCQ 55.54 -> 76.54 on DriveLMM-o1), then latent-thought distillation to a fast student (abstract; latency figures not checked).
thesis_use: contrast (motivates why a call budget matters; tool-free alternative to the always-on baseline).

title: BeyondSight: Object Permanence for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
relevance_note: MED — nuScenes-Permanence adds supervision and observability-conditioned evaluation for fully occluded actors.
what: Persistent actor hypotheses through occlusion; detection of unobservable actors goes from 0 to 0.249 (metric name cut off in my fetch; UNVERIFIED).
thesis_use: occlusion evaluation reference; contrast of memory vs. active query.

title: Think at 5 Hz, Act at 20 Hz: Asynchronous Fast-Slow Vision-Language-Action Inference for Closed-Loop Driving
relevance_note: MED — frozen 7B VLM exposes its per-layer KV cache as a standing scene representation; a fast action expert attends to it, trained under randomised staleness.
what: LangAuto-Short in CARLA: route completion 37.0 to 94.0 over a frame-skipping baseline; expert transfers zero-shot to two unseen towns (84-94% RC). Waypoint error about 4x lower than the backbone's own action head in open loop.
thesis_use: idea to borrow (cache and staleness augmentation for cached VLM features); template for a frozen-VLM-plus-small-head design.

title: Deferred Exposure of Future Trajectories for Verifiable Reasoning in Autonomous Driving VLMs
relevance_note: MED — AD-MCQ casts planning as multiple-choice over explicit trajectory candidates, with RLVR (DEFT-RLVR).
what: Shows teacher CoT anchored on the revealed GT trajectory is less faithful; reveals candidates only after the first-turn plan commitment (details from the abstract and a search summary).
thesis_use: benchmark-format idea (candidate MCQ with verifiable answer) for the ranker or for prompting a VLM.

title: SafeCommit: Certifying When Memory-Grounded Agents May Safely Act
relevance_note: MED — conformal action certificate across plausible worlds; if not certified, picks a low-side-effect *probe* targeting the blocking worlds, or a conservative fallback. Accept / probe / fallback is the shape of the planned policy.
what: Calibrated set of latent worlds from memory, observations, tool outputs; action allowed only if safe in every retained world. Text/memory agents.
thesis_use: idea to borrow (probe chosen by which hypotheses block certification, analogous to candidate-conditioned query).

title: DA-WAM: Decision-Aligned Future Latents for Driving World Models
relevance_note: MED-HIGH — an action-conditioned predictor generates a distinct future latent per candidate; a multi-head scorer estimates planning factors; hard-negative post-training for geometrically similar trajectories with different safety outcomes.
what: SOTA among learned camera-based planners on NAVSIM-v1/v2 and Bench2Drive (abstract; no numbers in the abstract).
thesis_use: idea to borrow (candidate-conditioned representation so that the features reflect the distinction among candidates, which is the same motivation as a candidate-conditioned selector).

title: UDAV: Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive VLM Waypoint Planner
relevance_note: MED-HIGH (mechanism) — draws K stochastic VLM trajectory predictions, takes the medoid, and invokes a reconsideration stage only when the maximum waypoint-wise spatial dispersion exceeds a threshold. This is "gate an expensive call on disagreement among sampled trajectories".
what: UAV-guided UGV off-road navigation, 400 held-out queries. Mean ADE 147.4 px (deterministic) to 115.9 px (medoid) to 110.4 px (full planner); lowest P90/P95 errors even vs a K=10 consensus baseline (abstract). Not on-road driving, no perception tools.
thesis_use: closest mechanism precedent for conditioning an extra call on trajectory disagreement; cite as related work, and as a possible "trajectory-dispersion trigger" baseline.

title: SafeVantage: Vantage-Aware Memory for Reliable Embodied Decisions
relevance_note: MED — active acquisition chosen by expected reduction in terminal decision loss, with calibrated Yes/No/Abstain head.
what: Learned candidate-observability model predicts visibility at reachable viewpoints; view selection by expected decision-loss reduction accounting for cost. Embodied navigation/search.
thesis_use: idea to borrow (decision-loss-based acquisition + abstain).

title: Triggering Generalist Reasoning via Predictive Uncertainty for Dual-System VLA
relevance_note: MED — when to call a slow module, scored on success vs. call budget with an operating curve by threshold.
what: Uses cross-step dispersion of action re-predictions as an uncertainty trigger; on VLA-Arena it beats uncertainty baselines at matched call budgets (abstract). Manipulation, not driving.
thesis_use: closest budget-curve evaluation precedent; note its trigger is derived from the action plan's variation, which is a form of action-conditioned trigger (a partial analogue of candidate divergence, worth reading).

title: AutoAgent0: An Agentic Runtime for Safe Closed-Loop Driving
relevance_note: MED — runtime harness: independent detection skills, rule-based verifier checks proposed trajectories, recovery planning when nominal trajectory is unreliable. Shield/replan loop with perception skills.
what: Evaluated on Fail2Drive and NavSafe-inf; improved closed-loop robustness over single-expert execution (no numbers read).
thesis_use: competitor for accept/replan/fallback phase; not selective on queries.

title: How Murky Before a VLM Knows It Cannot See? Accuracy, Confidence and Abstention on a Physical Visibility Axis
relevance_note: MED — five small VLMs keep high confidence (internal 0.68-0.84, verbalized 0.61-1.00) after accuracy falls to chance in fog at V=1.95 m (1000 COCO scenes).
thesis_use: supports not trusting VLM verbalized confidence (consistent with VLM prompting saying "none"); related to Lost in Fog.

title: CovNav: Conformal Prediction-Guided Adaptive Inference for Object Goal Navigation
relevance_note: MED — CP prediction set decides when to escalate from fast to slow reasoning (only ambiguous queries escalate). A cost-vs-accuracy "when to think more" gate with CP.
thesis_use: idea (CP-gated escalation, budget curve).

title: KEPT: Conformal Keepouts Kept in Planning for Enclosed-Space Navigation in Degraded Sensing
relevance_note: MED — conformal margin conditioned on a label-free severity estimate under smoke/dust/fog so per-class coverage holds as degradation varies.
thesis_use: idea to borrow for severity-conditioned calibration across the three tool-noise levels.

title: Certifying the Information Value of Adaptive Tool Use
relevance_note: MED — defines adaptive information value (gain from choosing queries after seeing responses vs fixing them in advance under the same budget) and gives a finite-budget upper-bound certificate with heterogeneous query costs.
what: In network-diagnosis experiments, when models choose their own queries, adaptive querying underperforms pre-committed querying; externally optimized adaptive evidence gains 5.84 points on a positive-gap interface.
thesis_use: contradicts "LLM picks the tool" (consistent with the project's finding that the VLM says "none"); a way to argue an upper bound on selector gain given the tool interface.

title: VarioDrive: Adaptive and Diverse Reasoning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
relevance_note: MED — fast-slow inference: one plan for simple scenes, several preference-oriented plans (safety/efficiency/comfort) compared for complex scenes, then selects.
what: Generates and compares multiple candidate plans only when the scene is complex.
thesis_use: related to candidate-set generation conditioned on difficulty; trajectory critic angle.

title: Active Sensing and Deferred-Decision Trajectory Optimization for Robust Target Identification
relevance_note: LOW (downgraded from HIGH by X3 full-text read) — HIGH (idea only) — trajectory-dependent information acquisition over a candidate set, with a sensing budget and conformal candidate sets; closest conceptual neighbour, but not driving and not a tool selector.
what: Extends Deferred-Decision Trajectory Optimization, where trajectories to individual candidate targets stay coincident as long as possible, with a trajectory-dependent information-acquisition term that biases the shared segment toward regions enabling earlier target identification. Supports Bayesian and conformal candidate-set updates under distance-dependent sensing, with guarantees on recursive feasibility, belief concentration and fixed-time coverage of the raw conformal set. Simulations show better target identification than standard DDTO under limited sensing budget (no numbers in the abstract).
thesis_use: idea to borrow (value of a query depends on where candidate trajectories diverge); cite as related work for the candidate-conditioned premise and for conformal sets in the calibration phase.

title: AdaTurn: Budget-Aware Test-Time Scaling for Active Visual Perception Agents
relevance_note: LOW-MED — conditions an active-perception agent on a turn budget; image tasks. Accuracy-vs-turn-budget curves.
what: FA-DAPO turns the over-budget event into a trainable forced-answer step; raises VisualProbe-Medium from 36.7% to 47.6% at four turns.

title: Explicit Geometric Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action in Autonomous Driving
relevance_note: LOW-MED — grounds decision-critical 2D regions, then retrieves local 3D priors from a geometric foundation model interleaved into context; PlanningGrounding dataset. Always-on, not a selectable tool.
what: Introduces a planning-relevant grounding task and the PlanningGrounding dataset; localized 3D features are interleaved into the autoregressive context before trajectory generation. Abstract reports consistent gains in safety-critical planning across benchmarks, with no numbers given.
thesis_use: related (planning-relevant region grounding; a possible always-on baseline).

title: FASIONAD++ : Integrating High-Level Instruction and Information Bottleneck in FAt-Slow fusION Systems for Enhanced Safety in Autonomous Driving with Adaptive Feedback
relevance_note: LOW — pre-window; slow VLM system activates through uncertainty estimation.
what: Dynamic switching based on real-time uncertainty, with information-bottleneck feedback.
thesis_use: representative scene-uncertainty trigger.

title: Reinforcing VLMs to Use Tools for Detailed Visual Reasoning Under Resource Constraints
relevance_note: LOW — small VLMs trained with GRPO to use a zoom tool. General VQA.
thesis_use: background only.

title: Budget-Aware Tool Use Enables Effective Agent Scaling
relevance_note: LOW — finding that agents without "budget awareness" hit a ceiling when tool-call budgets grow; adds a Budget Tracker and a unified token+tool cost metric.
what: Web search agents; cost-performance Pareto frontier.
thesis_use: unified cost metric idea.

title: Context-Aware Conformal Prediction for VLM-Based Driving Scene QA (CA-CP)
venue: ICML 2026 workshop poster (Efficient Multimodal Question Answering, per WebFetch summary)
relevance_note: LOW for this sub-area (calibration side) — uses planner uncertainty and temporal stability of planned trajectories as extra calibration signals; 16,655 WaymoQA pairs, six VLMs, improved worst-slab conditional coverage (per search summary).
what: CA-CP adds planner features as external difficulty signals; on 16,655 WaymoQA pairs across six VLMs it improves worst-slab conditional coverage on all 6 VLMs, with KNN kernel-weighted quantiles best, at modest set-size increase.
thesis_use: for the conformal phase; candidate-spread as a conformal covariate is the same trick. Better covered by the calibration agent.

verified: page fetched via WebFetch summary (title, authors, 16,655 WaymoQA pairs, six VLMs, planner uncertainty and trajectory temporal stability as features); abstract text not seen verbatim.

title: Calibrate-Then-Act: Cost-Aware Exploration in LLM Agents
relevance_note: LOW — passes the agent an inferred prior over latent environment state so it can trade exploration cost against uncertainty (QA, file reading, synthetic task).
what: Abstract: explicit cost-benefit tradeoffs help agents find better strategies.
thesis_use: calibrated prior as input to the selector (cf. the project's calibration phase).

title: VLA-Thinker: Boosting Vision-Language-Action Models through Thinking-with-Image Reasoning
relevance_note: LOW-MED — VLA where perception is an invocable reasoning action; SFT then GRPO; 97.5% on LIBERO (abstract). Manipulation.
what: Both are scene/self-uncertainty-driven, not action-conditioned.
thesis_use: robotics counterpart of DriveAgent-R1.

title: Starve to Perceive: Taming Lazy Perception in VLMs with Constrained Visual Bandwidth
venue: ICLR 2027 submissions for the first two, others arXiv (ACTIVE-o3 also on an ICML 2026 poster page)
relevance_note: LOW — all budget-conditioned or RL-trained zoom/crop acquisition for VQA; AdaTurn raises VisualProbe-Medium from 36.7% to 47.6% at four turns; WATCH frames acquisition as budgeted optimal stopping.
what: Generic VLM active perception under turn or token budgets; none are driving planners.
thesis_use: budget-conditioning recipes; the optimal-stopping view for a multi-step version of the selector.

title: ToolChain-CRC: Conformal Risk Control for Agentic AI Under Retrieval and Tool-Use Drift
relevance_note: LOW-MED — trajectory-level accept-or-intervene rule with anytime alarm; text agents.
what: Step-level risk scores combined into trajectory risk, calibrated accept/intervene rule, drift-aware extension, anytime escalation via supermartingale. Shows final-answer-only calibration can miss retrieval/tool failures. Text agents, not driving.
thesis_use: CRC citation for multi-step extension.

title: Making Every Tool Call Count: Necessary Tool-Evidence Path Rewards for Agentic Vision-Language Models
relevance_note: LOW-MED — rewards that each tool call targets needed evidence; addresses redundant or off-target calls.
thesis_use: related work for "tool call quality" metrics.
